fieldNotes.site: New ~265,000 sq ft Performance Foodservice Denver DC (groundbreaking Sept 2022, completed late 2023). All imagery is construction-era: Street View Sept 2023 shows the building shell up and the perimeter fence installed but the site otherwise bare dirt; satellite tiles likewise show graded dirt around a completed building. Counts are projections for the finished facility.
fieldNotes.truckGate: A full-length black metal security/perimeter fence is installed along the Havana St frontage (clearly visible in Sept 2023 Street View). The property is fenced with a controlled entry off Havana St — classified as a controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No freestanding guard booth visible. Construction-era imagery shows the fence and entry but no completed gatehouse; a structure at the building SW corner resolves on max-zoom satellite as a projecting building bay, not a booth. guardShack set false with remoteGs true (fenced gated entry, no visible booth implies kiosk/app/remote check-in). Both flagged uncertain — construction-era imagery cannot confirm the finished check-in setup.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Refrigerated/distribution building of ~265,000 sq ft; dock face along the SE side. Band 25-50 projected; exact count not observable due to construction.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large graded area south and southeast of the building being built out as trailer parking; capacity 50+ projected.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entry apron and large undeveloped paved expanse — room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Commerce City industrial fringe NE of Denver — flanked by a drainage canal, open agricultural land to the east, and scattered industrial yards. Edge-of-metro industrial setting; classified Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale visible in construction-era imagery; cannot rule out.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the east side of the broader corridor but no spur visibly enters the property.
